summary: Audio8 TTS Realistic 0.6B: speaks 23 languages at 44.1 kHz in the speaker's own voice, cloned from a few seconds of the video, from Arabic, Hindi and Thai to Chinese, Cantonese, Japanese and Korean. The earlier Preview model, in 11 languages, can be picked in Configure. The model (1 GB) downloads on the first line and needs about 3 GB of memory. Slow on a CPU: each second of speech takes about two to three seconds to make.
author: Subtitld
license: Apache-2.0 (add-on, Audio8 TTS code and weights)

voices.display_name: Speaker's own voice (cloned from the video)

fields.label: Model
fields.help: Both are 0.6B and equally fast, and clone the same way. Lines in a language Preview doesn't speak use Realistic. Only one model is in memory at a time; switching downloads the other's 330 MB the first time.

fields.label: CPU threads
fields.help: 0 picks half the logical processors, at most 8.

fields.label: Don't send the subtitles of the reference clip
fields.help: Audio8 clones closest with the exact words of the reference clip, which Subtitld takes from its subtitles. Turn this on if those subtitles paraphrase the speech: the voice is then cloned from the clip's sound alone.

fields.label: Fallback reference clip
fields.help: Cloned by the speaker's own voice when Subtitld has no clip of the speaker to send: 3 to 30 seconds of one person speaking, WAV preferred.

fields.label: What the fallback clip says
fields.help: The exact words of the fallback clip. Leave empty to clone from its sound alone.
